hero.title: Enter Nigeria with structure, tax clarity and on-the-ground leadership
hero.description: For foreign parents, investors and diaspora founders—we design entity setup, registration, tax posture and finance leadership so your first year in market is defensible to home-country boards and Nigerian regulators.

intro: International groups often underestimate the sequencing of CAC registration, FIRS and state tax IDs, banking KYC, and payroll before revenue scales. KACERTIFIEX leads Nigeria delivery partner-to-partner, coordinating with your home advisers where needed.
